programme.desc: Renowned herpetologist Nirut Chomngam takes viewers on a wild journey across the country in an unforgettable adventure filled with deadly encounters, as he joins conservation teams tasked with protecting these astonishing creatures and their jungle home

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: Singing louder than any animal on earth, humpback whales are famous for their haunting songs and jaw-dropping acrobatics They were hunted to the brink of extinction until a moratorium on killing them was implemented in the 1960s But after finally rebounding in numbers, whaling nations are exploring ways to re-open the hunt In Antarctica, Japan is targeting minke, fin, and now humpbacks

programme.title: Shark Gordon
programme.desc: The Oceanic White Tip is one of the only sharks that makes Ian Gordon nervous Fast, aggressive pack-hunters, these sharks wander the open ocean preying on whatever they can find

programme.title: Animal Society
programme.desc: Explore the worlds of hooved animals from deer and rhinos to pigs and goats A diverse collection of some of the most interesting animals in the world

programme.title: Safari Flix
programme.desc: Safari Flix is hosted by an experienced rangerguide who provides compelling in-the-moment narration on the action as it happens Not only will viewers marvel at the incredible wildlife sightings featured in the show, but so too will they be exposed to a wealth of information on the animals in particular and the African bush and pressing environmental matters in general

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #5

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #6

programme.title: 海賊王女 #11

programme.title: 海賊王女 #12
programme.desc: 佛蘭茲留給菲娜的是她作為巫女的使命。在伊甸的悲痛抉擇長年在少女間傳承,而菲娜也不例外地面臨窘境。她一心想著雪丸與夥伴並做出影響命運的選擇──!

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #1
programme.desc: 白石純太是存在感薄弱的少年,連同學和老師都察覺不到其存在,因此無法登上名為青春的大舞台。然而坐在他隔壁的同學・久保渚笑卻發現了白石的存在。有天久保好奇在大家眼中白石的存在感究竟有多低,於是向他搭話,還說他在上課時站起來或許也不會被發現。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #2
programme.desc: 白石期待地去買最愛的漫畫新刊,興致勃勃的他抵達書店後發現因為自己存在感薄弱,自動門竟然沒有反應,使他進不去!此時恰巧路過的久保成功替呆站在原地的他解圍。 久保對白石喜歡的漫畫感興趣,雖然決定向他借閱……。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #3
programme.desc: 阿久津帥氣地救出了在街上被搭訕的莉莉。儘管對遲到的阿久津感到生氣,兩人卻依舊直接前往約會……不,是前往狩獵惡魔。莉莉懷疑最近頻繁發生的野犬襲擊事件是惡魔的所為,於是她便和阿久津一同在街道中展開探索。然而,卻有一道殺氣騰騰的目光正注視著他們。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #4
programme.desc: 莉莉遇到了獸型惡魔,並與其展開了激烈的戰鬥。阿久津因夾在同族與莉莉之間而陷入兩難,他為了想辦法平息事態而介入了他們的戰鬥。然而,同族卻將阿久津視為叛徒,而莉莉則警告阿久津不要妨礙她,不然就將他給淨化。這時,被逼到絕境的阿久津思考出了一個辦法。

programme.title: 海賊王 #10
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.desc: 白石期待地去買最愛的漫畫新刊,興致勃勃的他抵達書店後發現因為自己存在感薄弱,自動門竟然沒有反應,使他進不去!此時恰巧路過的久保成功替呆站在原地的他解圍。 久保對白石喜歡的漫畫感興趣,雖然決定向他借閱……。

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 #12
programme.desc: 奎達工廠受到一對高達的攻擊。和蘇萊塔走散了的米奧莉奈為了與她重聚而走遍整個工廠。與此同事,蘇萊塔為了拯救米奧莉奈,決定向前邁進。

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 SEASON2 #13
programme.desc: 奎達工廠的事件發生在兩個星期前。蘇萊塔在學院裡,期待著再次見到米奧莉奈。

programme.title: 海賊王 #10
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #3
programme.desc: 阿久津帥氣地救出了在街上被搭訕的莉莉。儘管對遲到的阿久津感到生氣,兩人卻依舊直接前往約會……不,是前往狩獵惡魔。莉莉懷疑最近頻繁發生的野犬襲擊事件是惡魔的所為,於是她便和阿久津一同在街道中展開探索。然而,卻有一道殺氣騰騰的目光正注視著他們。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #4
programme.desc: 莉莉遇到了獸型惡魔,並與其展開了激烈的戰鬥。阿久津因夾在同族與莉莉之間而陷入兩難,他為了想辦法平息事態而介入了他們的戰鬥。然而,同族卻將阿久津視為叛徒,而莉莉則警告阿久津不要妨礙她,不然就將他給淨化。這時,被逼到絕境的阿久津思考出了一個辦法。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #2
programme.desc: 室井昌幸在11年前於雪山被雪女救了一命。他遭受夥伴與妻子的背叛,從此變得極度不信任別人,後來他搬遷至山腳小鎮,在遇見雪女的那座山附近定居。當昌幸在鎮上散步時,竟偶然看到和那位雪女長得一模一樣的女性。

programme.desc: 保羅教導當地的聖徒如何促進教會內的合一、如何學習神的事。透過寇紹涵牧師講解,進深研讀記載在哥林多前書中保羅的教導,即使周遭充斥著許多邪惡的事物,亦幫助我們明白要過正義生活的教義和原則。

programme.title: 福音電影: 天地孩兒
programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯救早產嬰兒的交通系統(Newborn Emergency Transport Service,簡稱 NETS)。在短短三年間,一共協助搶救了5437名初生及早產嬰兒。

你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷奇教練等。藉著十個見證者的親身經歷,讓觀眾明白他們如何靠著基督信仰跨過生命中最難熬過的難關。

programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷奇教練等。藉著十個見證者的親身經歷,讓觀眾明白他們如何靠著基督信仰跨過生命中最難熬過的難關。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 王良牧牧師- 神蹟醫治
programme.desc: 曾經是中國腫瘤科外科醫生,現在是美國基督工人神學院教牧博士的王良牧牧師,詳細講解什麼是神蹟醫治。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 福音電影: 最危險人物
programme.desc: 「一代賊王」葉繼歡今晨於瑪麗醫院羈留病房因癌症病逝,終年55歲。 這個曾經手持AK47在街上亂槍掃射、令人聞風喪膽的賊王在被捕、越獄後再犯案。一次偷渡回港時,中槍被捕,成為半身癱瘓的囚犯。 葉繼歡於2004年歸信耶穌,2010年更親筆回信給《天使心》。 今天,小編在整理葉繼歡的書信時,發現了這一句話: 「最後,我想講嘅就係,主令我改變。」

programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷奇教練等。藉著十個見證者的親身經歷,讓觀眾明白他們如何靠著基督信仰跨過生命中最難熬過的難關。

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:我們真的自由了? 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 點心、茶、茶樓有何相關歇後語？鄭寶鴻細談昔日「飲茶」掌故，還講解「單料銅煲」、「混吉」的出處。主持們到訪刀具店、旗袍店與影樓，實地了解與刀、布、攝影器材等有關的歇後語。廖舜禧帶來「唔使問阿貴」的典故。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 主持在花墟測試街坊對植物、交通、金錢相關歇後語的認識；及後前往粥店與餅家，探索「亞茂整餅」等與美食有關歇後語。鄭寶鴻細說「陸榮庭睇相」出處。廖舜禧帶來「牛o趙牡丹」的「o趙」、「筍盤」的「筍」正寫。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 唔玩唔知身體好，唔測唔知時運高。陳嘉桓、連詩雅用求籤方式配對隊員後，進行連串「身體檢查遊戲」。氣球及石春路結合，證實連詩雅很久沒有夜蒲，亦看出張振朗、何浩文身體不濟。牙膏放在地上任踩，有人聲勢大卻得低分數，甚至有負分出現！張振朗跳群體竹舞時兩度連累隊友，還高呼錯不在他！罪魁禍首是甚麼？何君誠及何浩文頭戴VR眼鏡玩平衡木，當中有人極度畏高，甚至飆冷汗！出線一隊向許願樹拋橙，神明會否保佑他們收到禮物？

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 實習生們將分為兩組，分別前往神樹坪基地和都江堰基地參與實習。本集馬曉鈺、楊與和龍斌會在都江堰基地體驗照料年老大熊貓的工作，面對生命步入倒數階段的熊貓，他們各自抱著不同的心情，從中學習和成長。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 黛雅個性突變，跟以往判若兩人，虹之咲為此深感擔心，試圖詢問事情的原委，卻聯絡不上黛雅，黛雅也一直沒有出現。就在這時，黛雅以直播主身分突然出現，更讓直播淪為惡作劇節目，令整個星夢頻道陷入一片混亂……

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日 及 防災貼士你要知2粵
programme.desc: 為了備戰寶石時裝大賽，瑪莉亞與鈴一起努力練習，但當瑪莉亞知道大賽是單人形式，而不能組隊參加便大受打擊。黛雅見狀，說了一句「討厭的話不如退出吧」，就讓瑪莉亞把一心橫，決定退出寶石時裝大賽……

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 愚人節來臨，大雄因為受騙太多次而拒絕相信任人，多啦A夢於是借他「謊話成真胸針」去教訓別人。大雄收拾雜物時找到一批故事書，因為放不下當中的悲劇情節，便與多啦A夢一起走進書中改寫結局。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: THRIVE請暢銷歌曲創作人粟津義真幫忙寫新歌，但暢銷的背後其實隱藏著後者自己的堅持。三人對音樂的熱情沒因粟津對完美的執著而讓步，最終一場現場直播的電視音樂節目，讓事情往意想不到的方向發展。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 晨早醒來，來一客「四大金剛」老上海早餐，新鮮出爐的加大粢飯、鹹豆腐花、甜豆漿配油條，好滿足。糖妹、婭溦出發掃街，熱辣辣即製排骨年糕、地道蛋餅熱身；怎少得日式食店內的抹茶雪榚，還可體驗正宗抹茶原味？女生對甜品有第二個胃，賣相繽紛的反傳統曲奇燒，配以芝麻滿圓味、海鹽太妃味激新口味。吃貨們首嚐人氣「夜包子」宵夜，網紅火鍋包辣動味蕾。今集最終站，「溦糖」到訪非一般打卡Cafe，皆因店內有超萌羊駝駐場！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 馬友除了是醃製鹹魚的上佳品種，新鮮的馬友亦肉質肥美。6號為肥媽找來一條斤両十足的新鮮馬友，由她炮製一魚四吃！阿媽把果皮切絲並釀進魚中，做出「薑蔥果皮蒸馬友腩」，魚肉滲出陣陣清香。她又參照日式煮法，奉上「鹽燒馬友魚骹」。「乾煎馬友尾」則是佐飯佳餚，惹味醬汁怎樣調製？還有採用魚頭、魚骨煮成的靚湯，鮮甜滋味。處理魚鮮，下酒或其他調味料，未必能完全辟除腥味。肥媽提到這與清洗過程中，沒徹底清理魚的某處有關？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 適逢兒童節，肥媽特意設計一系列開心「有營」食譜，還有助孩子戒除偏食習慣。「原味鮮雞汁」用上本地農場鮮雞烹調，無添加藥材成分，大人、小朋友同樣合適進補。洋薏米的升糖指數偏低，阿媽順應健康潮流以這「超級食物」炮製雜菌燴飯，美味指數有增無減。「牛油果鮮蝦米紙卷」色彩繽紛，賣相吸引。肥媽另採用高纖麥片加入雞肉作餡料，煎焗而成的餃子格外嫩滑香濃！6號今集跟肥媽的「親密」接觸引來錄影廠哄堂大笑，究竟發生何事？

programme.title: 防災貼士你要知2粵
programme.desc: 災禍無情，為保障生命及財產安全，廣大市民務必時刻保持高度的防災意識。由馮盈盈、何晉樂等「星級」藝員參演的《防災貼士你要知 2》，以短劇形式向大家傳遞防止災害發生、遇危難時逃命的貼士,，還有消防處代表帶來相關知識與實用資訊。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃曼谷粵
programme.desc: 澄光、星妤偕慧中分途覓食，孖妹在街頭找到炭火蛋糕仔，澄光則獨享融合中泰風味的茶記早餐。Cafe位於著名購物商場內，以花園風格佈置適合打卡，食品亦具質素，讓大家可於「血拼」期間休息一番。海鮮粥店外會掛起大魚作招徠，店裡粥品亦鮮味十足。唐人街內的潮州菜館，大廚堅持用炭爐炒菜，炮製出蠔餅、菜脯蛋、炸蝦棗等佳餚。此外，手製「榴槤雪糕」又有多香滑？入夜，主持們在高空酒吧回顧這趟曼谷之旅，各有甚麼深刻行程？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 周嘉洛、陳瀅、JW王灝兒、朱敏瀚約好去旅行，怎料嘉洛要拍劇而未能同遊？三人帶着失望抵達清邁酒店，酒店員工中有一奇怪身影，縱近距離遇上，仍未察覺有異？走進咖啡店，大家邊喝特飲邊談夢想，JW提議陳瀅可用腳踩葡萄釀紅酒？及後品嚐泰式甜品，朱仔一時口快，氣得陳瀅掟羹？來到田野，兩男親自動手製作鐵桶燒雞，好惹味。行逛當地夜市，JW、朱仔實試火焰按摩。合力幫朱仔完成此行的願望清單，朱仔竟要拍檔相伴一起食蟲……

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 歐陽巧瑩心思慎密、貼心周到，自然受朋友歡迎，難怪奪得2013年度港姐「友誼小姐」名銜。巧瑩更向古嘉俊(阿古)請教做一款沒有雞蛋成份的「牛奶朱古力黃梅芒果蛋糕」，希望照顧到對雞蛋敏感的好友，一同感受美味喜悅。牛奶朱古力與味道帶酸的黃梅、芒果取得平衡，口味清新又開胃。阿古又為黃梅鏡面加入金粉，令作品更添高貴氣派。巧瑩品嚐美味蛋糕之餘，還分享與同屆冠軍陳凱琳的美味經歷，更大讚其冠軍級廚藝。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴正式加入超鐵機，與一眾職員打招呼，並從高輪口中得知新幹線戰士被研發出來的來龍去脈。未知再次出現，地點是良太的故鄉敦賀，太晴馬上出動，決意守護盛載與姐姐的回憶的敦賀鐵路資料館。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 雨天予人陰沉的感覺，但只要懂得享受其中，雨天都可以討人歡喜。「My Little Show」，十位可愛小朋友以歌聲配合動作，訴說<Singin’ in the rain的樂趣。長笛音色清澈柔和，十歲男生以長笛演奏一段優美的樂曲，還提到每次上台演出前都感到緊張，可有放鬆心情的方法？家人是我們的最強後盾，結他導師引領Tiffany姐姐、瀅仴姐姐透過合唱<給最愛女兒的說話和<爸爸，表達對至親的愛。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 袁智慧如常在街上進行拉票活動，卻發現途人竊笑，詢問之下驚見自己的海報全部遭人掉包，樹熊妹妹提出不該老是依賴屁屁偵探，萬事OK俱樂部於是再次出動，在屁屁偵探陪同下嘗試找出犯人。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子、小玉和藤木去到小翠祖父朋友的農場摘檸檬，用新鮮檸檬炮製的檸檬水甜美可口。小丸子為添置新裝，提議拍攝全家福，最終成事，惟拍攝途中下雨，以為要中止之際，小丸子提議在家中拍攝。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 這十年幸福中國粵
programme.desc: 本片從城市到鄉村，以科技、社會、民生、體育、文化等多個角度出發，用小故事展現大主題、用小視角透視大時代，記錄各行各業普通人的工作與生活，體現幸福是奮鬥出來的思想。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 星期日檔案粵 及 防災貼士你要知2粵
programme.desc: 農曆新年唔少得各式各樣的糕點，傳統柴火蒸的年糕，香甜軟糯，新派的賀年糕點時髦又得意。全家團圓，品嚐糕點，只望步步高陞，馬到「糕」成。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 有市民透過積金易平台申請將強積金轉移至新公司，餘額驚見只剩數千元？另有事主被老朋友遊說購買其任職的連鎖電器店禮券，對方聲稱是公司要求「追業績」，但一直未有「找數」。金價上漲，回收價亦水漲船高，卻有人將「金包銀」的銀飾當金飾到金店放賣，行內人士細說查核金飾的六大步驟，為何仍有人成功以假亂真？大律師概述相關法例及罰則。新劇《臥底嬌娃》即將首播，眾演員出席宣傳活動，這集帶來活動花絮。

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻:中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 四十強選手依歌曲分為五人一組舉行團戰，將有四人被淘汰。企鵝人隊練歌時，團戰導師張家誠對眾人的和音表現甚擔心，可會有成員<到此為止？全由PK戰五燈歌者組成的隊伍帶來<手放開，但有評審指配合方面欠佳。白眉鷹王、獅子王等齊組<最佳損友，某評審認為隊中沒人特別出色？貓女郎在內的四女一男組合演繹<情人知己，有女隊員唱畢已落淚。由唯一等合成的「聯合國」團隊，唱出<沒那麼簡單其間，似乎有人忘記歌詞！

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 踏入第四季的《中年好聲音》誕生不少「大魔王」，反過來由參賽者揀出評審中的大魔王，某人高票當選！肥媽的一燈被喻為「長明燈」，背後原來有故事？海兒於新一季的衣著有進步，皆因身邊一個人！周國豐曾是公務員，月薪一查就知，參與《中聲》已為他換來接近待遇？問張佳添誰是歷季最美歌者，支支吾吾後才有答案？「中聲家族」成員拍片向四位評審發問，結論是主持許文軒「無乜朋友」？眾評審的感情狀況令人好奇，肥媽亦要協助逼供！

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 大廚葉世昌師傅帶暉哥到訪一棟歷史建築物，於環境雅緻的餐廳品嚐海南雞飯、原隻蝦多士，以及蓮蓉西米焗布甸，令人食指大動。廖慧儀駕車帶胡美貽到元朗的隱世泰國餐廳，享用火山排骨、爆汁脆皮燒雞等佳餚，滋味「泰」正宗！港韓混血兒李明憲帶伍倩彤品嚐堪稱「韓式煲仔飯」的石鍋拌飯，配料豐富，他示範正宗吃法，並細說與港式煲仔飯的分別。尖沙咀地標大廈的地庫開設美食廣場，可嚐到冬蔭公湯、手工意粉等多國美食，滿是驚喜滋味！

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#2粵PG
programme.desc: 晟杰找到Cici一案的目擊證人，得知健國曾經找過她，故設局引蛇出洞。健國犯案時被曉晨當場逮到，但他對梁曦的死一無所知。為了找出真相，曉晨決定以梁曦的身分到香港調查，但公司裡關於Roger Lee的檔案都被封鎖了…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 有市民透過積金易平台申請將強積金轉移至新公司，餘額驚見只剩數千元？另有事主被老朋友遊說購買其任職的連鎖電器店禮券，對方聲稱是公司要求「追業績」，但一直未有「找數」。金價上漲，回收價亦水漲船高，卻有人將「金包銀」的銀飾當金飾到金店放賣，行內人士細說查核金飾的六大步驟，為何仍有人成功以假亂真？大律師概述相關法例及罰則。新劇《臥底嬌娃》即將首播，眾演員出席宣傳活動，這集帶來活動花絮。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃曼谷粵
programme.desc: 澄光帶慧中、星妤品嚐潮汕美食「粿汁」，滋味秘密來自一鍋胡椒湯底。四位主持齊齊食漢堡，除牛肉外，用素肉、吞拿魚製成的漢堡扒亦有驚喜。星妤、慧中體驗三款特色水療，何解星妤感覺仿如置身死海？一間店可滿足主持們吃泰菜與歎咖啡兩大要求，供應的泰國東北部菜餚味道有何特色？澄光、慧中尋訪人氣「芒果糯米飯」，據稱做法源於皇官！夜市聚餐由星妤請客，「火山排骨」體積巨大得驚人，還有材料豐富的海鮮拼盤，眾拍檔開懷大嚼。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃曼谷粵
programme.desc: 曼谷的潮式牛腩麵名店，內裡竟可打邊爐？看見海寧在陶瓷上繪畫，原來她置身一間結合手繪陶瓷體驗的咖啡店。店內還遇上狗店長，「女神」更主動求吻！三位女神再次享受矜貴SPA，慧中和星妤的眉心被放上石塊再滴油，感受如何？澄光推介的豬手美食究竟有多滋味，讓星妤不顧儀態一口把豬皮往嘴裡塞？海寧發掘一間環境清新的純素餐廳，並可找到Pizza、擔擔麵等多國食品。慧中、星妤、澄光坐船暢遊湄南河，還以夕陽作伴寫意打卡。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 歐陽巧瑩心思慎密、貼心周到，自然受朋友歡迎，難怪奪得2013年度港姐「友誼小姐」名銜。巧瑩更向古嘉俊(阿古)請教做一款沒有雞蛋成份的「牛奶朱古力黃梅芒果蛋糕」，希望照顧到對雞蛋敏感的好友，一同感受美味喜悅。牛奶朱古力與味道帶酸的黃梅、芒果取得平衡，口味清新又開胃。阿古又為黃梅鏡面加入金粉，令作品更添高貴氣派。巧瑩品嚐美味蛋糕之餘，還分享與同屆冠軍陳凱琳的美味經歷，更大讚其冠軍級廚藝。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 晨早醒來，來一客「四大金剛」老上海早餐，新鮮出爐的加大粢飯、鹹豆腐花、甜豆漿配油條，好滿足。糖妹、婭溦出發掃街，熱辣辣即製排骨年糕、地道蛋餅熱身；怎少得日式食店內的抹茶雪榚，還可體驗正宗抹茶原味？女生對甜品有第二個胃，賣相繽紛的反傳統曲奇燒，配以芝麻滿圓味、海鹽太妃味激新口味。吃貨們首嚐人氣「夜包子」宵夜，網紅火鍋包辣動味蕾。今集最終站，「溦糖」到訪非一般打卡Cafe，皆因店內有超萌羊駝駐場！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 馬友除了是醃製鹹魚的上佳品種，新鮮的馬友亦肉質肥美。6號為肥媽找來一條斤両十足的新鮮馬友，由她炮製一魚四吃！阿媽把果皮切絲並釀進魚中，做出「薑蔥果皮蒸馬友腩」，魚肉滲出陣陣清香。她又參照日式煮法，奉上「鹽燒馬友魚骹」。「乾煎馬友尾」則是佐飯佳餚，惹味醬汁怎樣調製？還有採用魚頭、魚骨煮成的靚湯，鮮甜滋味。處理魚鮮，下酒或其他調味料，未必能完全辟除腥味。肥媽提到這與清洗過程中，沒徹底清理魚的某處有關？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 適逢兒童節，肥媽特意設計一系列開心「有營」食譜，還有助孩子戒除偏食習慣。「原味鮮雞汁」用上本地農場鮮雞烹調，無添加藥材成分，大人、小朋友同樣合適進補。洋薏米的升糖指數偏低，阿媽順應健康潮流以這「超級食物」炮製雜菌燴飯，美味指數有增無減。「牛油果鮮蝦米紙卷」色彩繽紛，賣相吸引。肥媽另採用高纖麥片加入雞肉作餡料，煎焗而成的餃子格外嫩滑香濃！6號今集跟肥媽的「親密」接觸引來錄影廠哄堂大笑，究竟發生何事？

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 實習生們將分為兩組，分別前往神樹坪基地和都江堰基地參與實習。本集馬曉鈺、楊與和龍斌會在都江堰基地體驗照料年老大熊貓的工作，面對生命步入倒數階段的熊貓，他們各自抱著不同的心情，從中學習和成長。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#40粵
programme.desc: 有義被公司看中，選他為代表到大學演講。眾人認為有義的演講詞能振動人心，但懶音太多，令演講失色不少。有義親眼看到眾人因言語不通而出醜，要眾修讀語文課程，眾齊聲指責他是「懶音王」。有義碰上暗戀多時的家敏。

programme.title: 天龍八部#13粵普PG
programme.desc: 喬峯威脅譚公說出誰是帶頭大哥，不料譚婆和趙錢孫被殺，譚公自殺，之後單家被人放火燒死，玄慈等人喬裝，試探喬峯是否真兇。智光大師告訴喬峯當年雁門關外之事後服毒自盡，喬峯改回蕭姓，與扮成白長老的阿朱找康敏…

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺先帶阿譚到順德食餐住家飯，讓她明白食材好吃無需多配料。返回廚房，鼎爺再簡單用瘦肉、豬肥肉與大豆芽帶來「大豆芽炒肉鬆」。肥、瘦肉的黃金比例如何？另加蝦乾、燒肉炮製的「火腩蝦乾爆炒大豆芽」，怎樣做方能避免大豆芽出水？主持們親赴南海竹林掘竹筍，掘起後十二小時內享用，竹筍特別鮮甜！鼎爺回港後參考南海人做法，用心煲一鍋「竹筍拆魚粥」。阿爺還體貼拆走魚骨，並加入縲絲螺提鮮，縱花時間，但可換來稱讚絕對值得！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 日本腦炎是經蚊子傳播的疾病，輸血、器官移植也有可能感染，小朋友與戶外工作人士屬於高危群組；症狀與普通感冒相近，但潛伏期可長達十四日！治療方面，兒科醫生指並無針對藥物，最好做足預防措施，如外遊前接種疫苗。李樂詩、文佩玲與何婉盈近期組成女團Super Queens，樂詩、佩玲到來受訪，暢說女團各人分工，二人如何分配時間予工作和家庭，以及調理身體？「睇餸食飯」，營養師陳國賓示範一道「錦繡豬肉卷小炒」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在廣州粵
programme.desc: 廣州，粵菜發源地之一，廣府菜的中心，是每一位食客都無法拒絕的美食聖地。愛吃愛玩的主持人麥包，在廣州徹底釋放了吃貨天性，走遍大街小巷，尋找地道美食：悠閑早茶、西關小吃、新潮佳饌，夜市小攤

programme.title: 單戀雙城#14粵
programme.desc: 專榮承認酒後糊塗，書舒欲割脈自殺。慧敏跪地請書舒原諒她與專榮做錯事。展禛決定把偷拍片段刪除，比賽結束後亦會回加拿大。主席評判黎中諸多挑剔，錢進及時把雞蛋給展禛，解開在山上做馬卡龍的特別味道之謎。

programme.title: 灼熱卡巴迪粵日
programme.desc: 宵越進攻成功拿下3分，本以為能為能京創造有利局勢，沒久就因高谷的大量得分，與六弦的完美防守被逆轉，分數差距更逐漸拉開。而畦道在防守中途受傷，更令能京精神上受到更大打擊，能夠挽救這劣勢的，果然還是……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 不少人喜歡收藏具紀念價值或別有意義的物品，這次「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓分享其珍藏，包括有數十年歷史的炮竹紙、錢罌等。觀眾透過這些物品，也可了解當年的社會文化，例如原來曾出現塑膠利是封。嘉賓又展示鐵皮鴨子玩具與香港舊紙幣，彤彤姐姐發現昔日的紙幣只有單面印刷。嘉賓還分享收藏心得，提醒要注意防蟲、防潮。如小朋友亦對收藏物品感興趣，他有甚麼建議？另外，本集將播放AI生成動畫《誠實的樵夫》。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 有人觸怒了胖虎，卻沒有被胖虎教訓。大雄以為胖虎心情很好，於是開始輕佻起來，結果自討苦吃。大家見到小夫的弟弟從美國回到了日本探親，都表現得很熱情。但小夫卻不知為何，好像不希望弟弟與大家見面。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 港島豪宅交投加快，北角一個連天台特色放盤，外望維港海景，質素如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2749粵
programme.desc: 凌凌將片場用作道具的一棵桃花帶回住所，隨後輾轉落入樹根手中。這棵桃花似乎能為人帶來好運，樹根因此獲得不少好處。壯想提升姻緣運，遂打算取回桃花。若水等人原本亦想讓壯帶走這棵妨礙出入的桃花，但在察覺其靈驗後便改變主意。壯前往探望Elaine，卻因遭遇阻滯而未能見到她，於是更加渴望得到桃花，詎料……最終，壯施計取回桃花，卻被城安識破。兩人爭奪之際，竟意外發現了一個出乎意料的真相……

programme.title: 臥底嬌娃#1粵PG
programme.desc: 毒品「粉精靈」流入市面，警方盯上權世豪的二世俱樂部。沈佳琪以顧問身分協助警方調查，潛入俱樂部，遇上經理潘奕風。奕風暗自疏散吸毒的富二代，再處理服用過量毒品的客人。奕風被警方問話，佳琪從其微表情發現他有所隱瞞。佳琪的表妹童小茹重遇警察學堂同學江妙姿，妙姿負責監聽二世員工朱皮。世豪欲擴大毒品市場，奕風聯絡私煙強幫手散貨。世豪找傅葉生談注資；二人相約驗貨，葉生暗中埋伏打手。危急間，奕風帶世豪從秘道逃走。

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#16粵普
programme.desc: 韶傑為荀之做牛做馬，成功讓央央入讀宏文館。央央知道林晏想接近荀之便自發幫助，韶光卻以為是林晏指使而怪罪他…荀之作客沈家，林晏問他關於永安鬻官案，荀之難掩悲傷。趙王知道林晏已查到荀之，不久荀之便失了蹤…

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻 :一馬當先行大運粵
programme.desc: 玲玲宴請年輕藝員莊子璇、倪樂琳及王汛文享用陳皮宴，本以為三人會問事業，怎料她們對感情事較着緊，其中兩位宜配成熟男？香氣可以催運？不妨據八字命格得出自己的五行屬相，再選用相應的發放香氣工具，並要擺對方位。每尊佛像有不同姿態，立佛、坐佛、臥佛的寓意如何？參觀佛山三水的巨型臥佛後，也可搜購陶瓷擺設催旺桃花、財運！碧霞師傅指點大門方位與催運佈置，窗外望見道路又是好是壞？另外，楓燧師傅帶來桃花位快速檢測法。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#9粵
programme.desc: 齊墨鉅子劍聖曹秋道追問鉅子令下落，少龍詐傻扮懵。善柔接到命令，要偷取鉅子令。少龍替趙倩改名小兔，自稱大牛，趙倩對少龍生好感。趙雅勸少龍離開邯鄲，坦言不知朱姬母子下落，少龍反勸她離開趙穆。少龍夜探趙穆府，得一夫人相救才免被趙穆發現，卻不知她就是朱姬。趙盤遭趙德等找晦氣被打至重傷，趙雅衣不解帶地照顧他又訴說苦衷，趙盤動容。少龍得知趙倩翌日回宮，遂帶她去市集開眼界。趙雅勸趙倩勿與大牛泥足深陷，趙倩沮喪。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 單戀雙城#14粵
programme.desc: 專榮承認酒後糊塗，書舒欲割脈自殺。慧敏跪地請書舒原諒她與專榮做錯事。展禛決定把偷拍片段刪除，比賽結束後亦會回加拿大。主席評判黎中諸多挑剔，錢進及時把雞蛋給展禛，解開在山上做馬卡龍的特別味道之謎。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#40粵
programme.desc: 有義被公司看中，選他為代表到大學演講。眾人認為有義的演講詞能振動人心，但懶音太多，令演講失色不少。有義親眼看到眾人因言語不通而出醜，要眾修讀語文課程，眾齊聲指責他是「懶音王」。有義碰上暗戀多時的家敏。

programme.title: 天龍八部#13粵普PG
programme.desc: 喬峯威脅譚公說出誰是帶頭大哥，不料譚婆和趙錢孫被殺，譚公自殺，之後單家被人放火燒死，玄慈等人喬裝，試探喬峯是否真兇。智光大師告訴喬峯當年雁門關外之事後服毒自盡，喬峯改回蕭姓，與扮成白長老的阿朱找康敏…

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

高朋滿座#41粵
programme.desc: 高慶專吃膽固醇高的食物，但膽固醇超標的竟是貪吃的有情。有情勉強戒吃肥膩東西，但一次舉家參予飲宴，有情爆發了，向家人哭訴「戒吃日子之苦」。溢滿陪她只吃麥皮充飢，不過溢滿不支，在有情的懷抱中暈倒。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 主持們來到海味店，選擇大眾化食材「煮靚餸」。鼎爺分享揀吊片貼士，並迎合拍檔的重口味喜好，炒出「椒鹽百花釀吊片」！洗吊片、蝦仁需花工夫，也要留意為吊片輕輕切花，以及打蝦膠的關鍵技巧。此外，香口椒鹽又怎樣調製？二人深入南海桂城，了解製作甜醋的傳統工序。煲甜醋配合柴火、藥材極其講究，學問多多！鼎爺及後以啖啖肉的豬肋條、「少爺雞」，分別帶來「糖醋豬肋條」和「唊醋大盆雞」，補身又健康，選用少爺雞還另有原因？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 小朋友如進食時含飯不吞或挑食，可能跟口肌發展、行為學習等有關。言語治療師細說相關原因，並為家長帶來改善建議，有助避免孩子出現發音含糊。龔慈恩憶述當年藉投考藝訓班入行，且學習過程非常愉快。她透露曾報讀課程希望進修演技，卻因赴內地參演《雪山飛狐》而擱置。回顧入行逾四十年，她感恩可從事自己熱愛的工作，並開心至今仍可繼續拍戲。對於女兒亦投身演藝圈，她有甚麼看法？「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐奉上「生煎胡椒雞」。

programme.title: 灼熱卡巴迪粵日
programme.desc: 下半場開始，王城與高谷展開激烈爭戰，成功將分數差距縮窄至4分。然而王城卻因提早出場，出現疲憊，為免能京的目標化為泡影，井浦阻止王城繼續擔任突襲者。王城理解井浦的想法，並將驅逐高谷的重任託付給宵越。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「廠長話」的遊戲設有熱身環節，薯片女兵出錯一次後就變得謹慎，卻令反應「慢半拍」，正式遊戲時又能否避免犯錯？有人亦因多舉了一隻手而被淘汰，真可惜！接下來要走入果園收集水果，某小兵為了節省時間，竟想一次過拿走兩件水果；另有小兵過於心急，兩度碰到障礙物。運送雪糕球比拼，曲奇小兵第三次過溶化之橋時要挑戰五個雪糕球，卻失敗而回，下一輪只好謹慎地減少雪糕球數量，最終累計成績能夠戰勝薯片小兵團嗎？

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 潮江文次郎與食滿留三郎相約決鬥，但留三郎卻在決鬥前患上感冒。亂太郎與伏木藏很空閒。為了解悶，伏木藏開始說刺激及懸疑的故事。亂太郎發現媽媽變裝成貴族，因此推斷媽媽正在進行忍者的工作。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易���下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 前列腺增生又叫前列腺肥大，是50歲以上男性，正常衰老的生理現象，亦是年長男性常見的病症。因荷爾蒙變化導致前列腺體積增大，儘管這種病屬於良性增生，但當腺狀組織不斷肥大，會壓迫尿道引起排尿困難、尿頻、夜尿增多以及尿流細小等。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2750粵
programme.desc: 敢威、雷公均想與細曹總洽談合作。雷公聘請醒獅隊祝賀細曹總獲獎；敢威不甘示弱，提到三名兒子亦早已學習醒獅，過年時將為細曹總表演。雷公遂提出屆時以醒獅作較量，勝出者即可獲得與細曹總合作的機會，細曹總亦贊成。敢威安排眾子接受特訓，璟風因力王挑選，被分配舞獅頭的辛苦崗位。他更察覺力王對Joe偏心，遂感不滿……其後，璟風、Joe因某些理由無法舞獅，力王唯有另找幫手，並向二人提到他熱衷舞獅的原因……

programme.title: 臥底嬌娃#2粵PG
programme.desc: 奕風先從秘道逃出，意外遇上佳琪。為了掩護世豪逃走，奕風上前與佳琪糾纏，佳琪意外受傷。佳琪的毒品調查科警司男友郭宗南往找奕風協助調查，卻被耍得團團轉。妙姿得知佳琪因看到自己手上的文件才推測到秘道出口，對佳琪的越界行為感不滿，佳琪不以為意。妙姿接到摯友蘇嘉盈的死訊，大受打擊。世豪收到神秘包裹，裡面竟是一張鑲了鑽石的信用卡，世豪滿意。奕風成功獲取世豪信任，獲告知製毒工場的地址，以及世豪的製毒師身分。

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#17粵普
programme.desc: 沈家人過除夕，鳳霞拿出韶傑寄給家裡的信，他說自己在通往頂峰的半路，但其實自離家後，他並沒有成功，甚至淪落到流浪街頭。飯後，長公主和裴斐來到沈家飯館，席間韶光叮囑林晏當心喝醉，裴斐卻指出林晏酒量極好…

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻：一馬當先行大運粵
programme.desc: 展望、蒨文隨李丞責到艇上食荔灣艇仔粥，再參觀西關民俗館，做一趟西關大少與小姐，兼了解箇中的風水建築設計。玲玲師傅率眾到人氣旺的室內滑雪場，以運動「啟動」運氣。丙午年屬旺火年分，滑雪「降火」最合適；也宜按出生季節，揀選運動種類！資深配音員黃鳳英去年多病痛，或跟配音室密閉環境有關？碧霞師傅還登門入室，教她風水化解法。璞初師傅示範古法催財，一杯水、有鎖錢箱藏鈔票即可！元海、海嫂則帶來開運衫顏色圖案指引。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#10粵
programme.desc: 廷芳見少龍與趙雅雙雙出現，妒火中燒不停灌酒，連晉輕薄廷芳，被少龍怒打一番。廷芳失足跌入河，少龍用人工呼吸救她。連晉向應元提親，並願離開趙穆，應元半信半疑。廷芳以為是少龍提親，欲拒還迎。連晉取得朱姬的信物給應元，又叫應元寫密函給朱姬。趙王質問密函一事，應元與少龍一唱一和脫罪，氣煞趙穆。廷芳游說趙倩要為自己爭取幸福，卻驚悉大牛就是少龍，晴天霹靂。廷芳與少龍借運馬糞為名，將趙倩暗藏木桶，出宮時赫見連晉。

programme.title: 家家行運菜粵
programme.desc: 三位主持帶你到一間素食菜館，品嚐南、北方的道地賀年素菜。老闆為大家炮製一道「三鮮慶豐年」，究竟是哪三種地上最新「鮮」的蔬菜？老闆還特別將金菇喬裝成「瑤柱」，配搭豆苗和豆腐，沒有添加任何葷食，卻同樣美味！提到敖嘉年，「大殿下」和「排骨仔」令他人氣大熱，今集擔任「行運嘉賓」的他廚藝一樣了得，他會與妹妹以蓮藕、魚蛋和西芹等食材，炮製「敖家」行運菜，見嘉年煮得有板有眼，難道他向曾身為廚師的爸爸「偷師」？

programme.title: 家家行運菜粵
programme.desc: 「速食文化」往往會令不少具保留價值的傳統慢慢失去，今集主持帶到一間經營超過四十年的中式廚具老店，看看這間老字號的傳統手藝「刨砧板」，「品嚐」當中豐富的人情味。店主的兩位兒子亦送上親手炮製的「豐衣足食」和「蒸蒸日上」。嫩滑多汁的雞肉，配上濃厚的湯汁，令「汽鍋雞」成為雲南獨有馳名佳餚，祖籍為雲南的方力申到來，在「方太」指導下首次下廚，親手炮製這道美味「行運菜」，他可否承傳家鄉味道，令「老方」食指大動？

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S1
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 監獄醫生(完)
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S1
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.desc: After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.

programme.title: The Man Called Noon
programme.desc: Rubal Noon blazes a trail of vengeance across the West after his family is massacred. No one is safe from his blood lusting fury. Suddenly, Noon is Ambushed and falls victim to loss of memory. A mysterious desperado comes to his aid for unknown reasons. Noon holds the secret to a fortune in gold. The desperado along with many others impatiently wait for Rubal Noon’s Memory to return. And when he does remember -- all hell breaks lose!

Despite dire warnings by fellow scientist Ted Rampian (Moore), Dr. Sorenson proceeds with the experiment after secretly learning that he is terminally ill. This experiment causes a crack to form and grow within the earth's crust, which threatens to split the earth in two if it is not stopped in time.

programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.title: The Takeover
programme.desc: Cédric works in a company specialized in precision mechanics. Its management, run by an investment fund, is disastrous. As another fund is about to buy it again, Cédric decides to take the company over, giving it to the employees.

programme.title: Murder Party
programme.desc: Jeanne, a brilliant architect, is appointed to restore the sumptuous Daguerre mansion owned by an eccentric family. When the patriarch is found dead during a murder party, Jeanne finds herself caught up in a real-life investigation to unmask the killer.

programme.title: Ricky
programme.desc: When Katie, an ordinary woman, meets Paco, an ordinary man, something magical and miraculous happens: a love story. From this union will be born an extraordinary baby: Ricky.

programme.title: Running To The Sky
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Jekshen is an exceptional runner living in a beautiful mountain village in Kyrgyzstan. Struggling to live with his divorced alcoholic father, Jeksen sees an upcoming big race as an opportunity to change his life for the better.

programme.title: Black As The Snow 3: Off Limits
programme.desc: A senior executive of a multinational company is murdered on a ski lift in the French Alps. Captain Meyer decides to investigate after learning that his ex-lover is a suspect. Accompanied by French Officer Vivier, he is determined to unravel the mystery.

programme.title: Aspromonte: Land Of The Forgotten
programme.desc: In 1959 in Africo, Aspromonte, a woman dies in childbirth because the lack of roads prevented the doctor from reaching in time. The tragedy unites the villagers and Giulia, a new teacher, to build a road. But Giulia must contend with local mafia Don Totó.

programme.title: Cortina Express
programme.desc: During the Christmas holidays in Cortina, a colorful cast of characters cross paths among the snow-capped Ampezzo mountains. Between love, redemption, and second-chances, their lives collide in a series of hilarious and heartfelt quests for a happy ending

programme.title: Cracks In Concrete
programme.desc: Ertan leaves jail after 10 years and tries to settle back in society. Mikail spends his time with parties, drugs and dreaming of a life as a gangster rapper. Ertan looks for Mikail. Mikail doesn't know Ertan. Soon they must face a harsh reality.

programme.title: The Rising Tide
programme.desc: When her father fails to return home, the sound of his boat’s engine is the only thing a daughter has to remember of him. Learning from an elderly mechanic, she wishes to repair her father’s boat in hope of his return.

programme.title: In His Hands
programme.desc: Clara, a lawyer, leads a serene but monotonous life alongside her husband Damien and their two children. One evening, she succumbs to the charm of a mysterious sculptor. This one scorching night will have dramatic repercussions for her and her family.

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po watch bunny rabbits. Bunny ears and tails appear on the Teletubbies. They do the 'bunny hop hop' before saying 'eh oh' to the Tiddlytubbies.

programme.title: Oath Of Death
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it...

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire's Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming's guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: This iconoclastic film retells the legend of seven Chinese patriots, who sacrificed their lives to defend against 20,000 Japanese soldiers and 50 tanks for 5 days, at a strategic key point of the Great Wall known as Pa Tou Lou Tzu.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: Skilled shadow Tai Chi boxer Ku Ting hides his skills by working as a construction worker. However, when the thugs assaulted his girlfriend, Ku Ting has no choice but to use his kung fu to show his enemies what it takes to keep justice in line.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Feng's innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: As the names of Chang Cheh and Liu Chia-liang became legendary, all-too-often the name of their equally valued collaborator, Tang Chia, is omitted. That may be, because, unlike the previous pair, the veteran kung-fu choreographer only went on to direct three movies of his own. Of course, that makes this trio all the more special, and this first effort perhaps the most special of all.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father's death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the "Toad Stance" and accidentally unveils his true identity...

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon "Thundering Sword" to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Bunshinsaba: Hoichi the Earless
programme.desc: You Mei brings home an abandoned doll found on the street. Little does she know that it is possessed by an evil spirit which causes the sudden death of her colleague. You Mei seeks help from a ghost hunter who unleashes the pencil spirit to fight against the evil spirit, unfortunately leading to a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

The Point with LIU Xin connects world audience through social media, enhancing their participation as well as offering a comprehensive perspective on world events.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: World Insight with Tian Wei
programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion. It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. Live debates linking movers and shakers take place in the signature segment "Global Debate".

programme.title: The Vibe
programme.desc: The Vibe is a 30-minute TV show that runs daily on weekdays on CGTN. The host presents various culture-related topics in a fun way while also doing some in-depth analysis to give viewers a fuller picture as to what is happening, and why it matters.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.
